title: 第七章 奖励明亮的眼睛
slug: 看见罪犯词条我成了警局团宠
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

黎雾眼睛瞬间就红了。

怎么可能没事。

她都快吓死了。

如果不是她能看到何明头顶的【杀人犯凶手】五个字。

真的傻愣愣的把昨晚发现的异常说出来，怕是此时躺在血泊中的就是她了。

黎雾快步上前

哽咽害怕到极致的嗓音响起：

“陆警官。”

陆云铮目光快速在屋内扫过一眼，抬手安抚的在黎雾肩膀上拍了拍：

“好了，没事，我来了。”

“你说那人是杀人犯，是怎么回事？”

陆云铮看过全国所有在通缉榜上的罪犯，没有任何人跟那人的长相相似。

细说起来，只听黎雾一人之言就直接把人给抓住，终究是有些冲动了。

但是不知为何，陆云铮下意识的选择了相信黎雾。

黎雾闻言没有耽搁，快速道：

“我昨晚回家的时候在路上看到他了，当时他走得太快，裤包里装了一把刀还有血，当时我没有看得太清楚。”

“但是没有想到今天他会扮成警察来问我，昨天有没有发现上面异常。”

“我当时就发现他不对劲了。”

“他说楼上一家三口都被灭门了。”

说到这里，黎雾的手有些抖。

楼上一家三口她在路上遇见过。

是一对年轻的小夫妻带一个孩子，为了孩子读书，才咬牙在云城买了房。

每次一家人带着小孩子出门都是欢声笑语的。

没想到……

黎雾咬了咬舌尖，控制心里突然泛起的冷意。

陆云铮闻言脸色顿时就冷了下来。

强硬道：

“你在这里等等，我上楼去看看。”

“我和你一起吧。”

黎雾拒绝，她觉得自己以后或许还会见到不少这样的场面。

不如从现在开始逐步适应。

陆云铮目光沉沉的落在黎雾的身上，不知想到了什么，没有多说什么。

转身抬步朝楼上走去，黎雾快速抬步跟上。

楼上6楼5号房房门紧闭，听不到任何从屋内传来的动静。

但是只是站在门口，黎雾就已经闻到了一股浓郁的血腥味。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Li Wu's eyes turned red instantly.

How could it be okay?

She was scared to death.

If she hadn't been able to see the words "Murderer" above He Ming's head.

She was really stupid and told the abnormality she discovered last night, fearing that she would be the one lying in a pool of blood at this moment.

Li Wu stepped forward quickly

A choked and frightened voice sounded:

"Officer Lu."

Lu Yunzheng quickly glanced around the room, raised his hand and patted Li Wu's shoulder comfortingly:

"Okay, it's okay, I'm here."

"You said that man is a murderer. What's going on?"

Lu Yunzheng had seen all the criminals on the wanted list across the country, and no one looked similar to that person.

To put it into detail, it was a bit impulsive to catch someone just by listening to Li Wu's words.

But for some reason, Lu Yunzheng subconsciously chose to believe Li Wu.

Li Wu didn't hesitate when he heard this and said quickly:

"I saw him on the road when I went home last night. He was walking too fast, and he had a knife in his pocket and there was blood. I didn't see it clearly at the time."

"But I didn't expect that today he would dress up as a policeman and ask me if I noticed any abnormalities above yesterday."

"That's when I realized something was wrong with him."

"He said that all three members of the family upstairs were wiped out."

Speaking of this, Li Wu's hands were shaking a little.

She had met the family of three upstairs on the street.

It was a young couple with a child who gritted their teeth and bought a house in Yuncheng in order for the child to study.

Every time the family goes out with their children, they laugh and laugh.

Unexpectedly...

Li Wu bit the tip of his tongue to control the sudden coldness in his heart.

Lu Yunzheng's face suddenly turned cold when he heard this.

He said forcefully:

"You wait here, I'll go upstairs and take a look."

"I'll come with you."

Li Wu refused. She felt that she might see many such scenes in the future.

It is better to adapt gradually from now on.

Lu Yunzheng's eyes fell heavily on Li Wu. He didn't know what he thought of, but he didn't say anything more.

Turning around and walking upstairs, Li Wu quickly followed up.

The door of Room 5 on the 6th floor was closed, and no sound could be heard from inside the house.

But just standing at the door, Li Wu could already smell a strong smell of blood.
